text: [file: Committee agenda Thu 3 Dec.pdf]
Thursday's agenda. Shout if anything's missing
Got it. Item 4 is mine, I'll have the minutes draft by Thurs morning
Ok thanks. Can we add the kit order to AOB? Supplier wants sizes by Friday
Yep add it
Stephen is item 3 the budget or the bar tab
Budget. Bar tab's under AOB
Ok. I'll have the Q3 numbers. Not great
Just off shift. Ava I'll send you the U16 numbers tmrw, been sorting the minibus
No rush just need the headcount before I book
Evening all. Christmas do, I've had quotes from the Irish pub on the 14th and the place on Scottsdale Rd. Will bring to Thursday
Christmas do on the agenda? Not seeing it
Under AOB Doug can present
Fine by me
Anyone know if the pitch booking for the 14th is still with the council or did we sort it
I think we did, check the email from Oct? I can dig it out tmrw
Ok thanks. Will check
Confirmed in Nov, I've got the invoice in my inbox
Cheers
Minutes draft is in the drive, folder "Dec committee". Item 4 is rough, I'll tidy it up later
Thanks! Can someone confirm kit sizes are going to me by tmrw? Supplier is being annoying
Is that the same supplier that shorted us last time
Yes that's why I want it right this time

U16 numbers

[file: U16 headcount Dec.xlsx]
Legend. How many confirmed? Need to know before I book the bus
38 confirmed, 3 maybe. One of the maybes is checking with his wife
Ok I'll book the 45 seater and we drop if it comes to it
Irish pub has come back with 60 covers max for the 14th. Scottsdale place says 70 but wants a deposit by the 10th. Thinking about it over lunch
Deposit is a lot to lose if we're under
Last year we had 58. Could be fewer this year
Just out of a site visit Fine by me to go with whichever is cheaper on the deposit. Don't fight over it tonight
Did anyone check the email from Oct re the pitch? Ava was asking
Kevin said it's confirmed, I'll take that

Q3 numbers in the pack. Bar is down. Subs about the same. Nothing awful but not good

[file: Q3 finance summary.pdf]

Bit of both. Sevens lost money on the bar but gate was ok
Will look at the minutes tonight. Bit stuck on a bridge thing 🙃
Clubhouse early, I've unlocked the hall. Who's bringing the urn
Coming. Bringing the cashbox
On my way, 5 mins
Bar tab sorted. Ava, kit money is approved
Yes thank you!! Sizes go to the supplier tomorrow morning
Home. Will send final minutes tmrw once Stephen's had a look
Yep. Need to finish the bridge thing first but I'll check before I sleep
Christmas do: going with the Irish pub, 60 covers, deposit by the 10th. Anyone against?
Works for me. Who's doing the raffle
Me. Obviously
Deposit cheque is signed, I'll drop it in Mon
Sorry fell asleep before I checked. Minutes look good

Kit sizes sent to supplier. Confirmation came through

[file: Kit order sizes Dec final.xlsx]

[file: Minutes 3 Dec final.docx]

Told you

He is now

Did you win
Pass.
